vocabulary.definition: relating to the universe or cosmos, especially as distinct from the earth
vocabulary.example: The cosmic radiation from distant stars reaches our planet.

vocabulary.definition: to move back or away from a previous position
vocabulary.example: The sound of the train receded into the distance.

vocabulary.definition: the action of inflating something or the condition of being inflated
vocabulary.example: Economic inflation can lead to a decrease in purchasing power.

vocabulary.definition: a hypothetical collection of multiple universes including the one which we inhabit
vocabulary.example: The concept of a multiverse raises intriguing questions about parallel realities.

vocabulary.definition: to make or become united, uniform, or whole
vocabulary.example: The treaty aimed to unify the two warring factions.

vocabulary.definition: a typical example or pattern of something; a model
vocabulary.example: The discovery of DNA as the genetic code was a paradigm shift in biology.
